about: Review of E3 v4 (filter v2.2) requested before shipping. Unsupported-line types were classified by the builder's AI assistant reading each line, its cited pack lines and the whole pack; not by the judge and not human-verified.

examples.line: payments approach or exceed the approval threshold
examples.cites: E5: agent_25 3 payments, each 53.7%-85.8% of its $250.00 threshold
examples.why: no payment exceeds the threshold; the near-threshold check missed 'approach or exceed'

examples.line: agent switched merchants between each payment
examples.why: the pack lists only the first five switches, and two merchants got repeat payments, so 'each payment' is not shown

examples.line: final payment went to a different merchant
examples.why: E20 is the last switch listed, not the last payment; the pack caps switches at five without saying so

examples.line: Payments were to a variety of trusted merchants across different categories
examples.why: true per E2 and E6-E15, but cites one merchant line; the judge also flagged it as arguing against the rule

examples.line: the largest share of funds went to an untrusted software merchant
examples.why: true ($935.45 vs $629.35 in E9), but the comparison needs E9 or E2

examples.line: Trusted merchant received the smaller payment
examples.why: true against E6, which it does not cite

also.line: the merchant list consists entirely of trusted categories
also.why: true per E6-E15, cites a switch line; judge flagged it as arguing against the rule

examples.line: the recipient is a trusted software provider
examples.why: E5 states exactly this; the judge objected that the line does not mention round amounts

examples.line: Untrusted merchant received the bulk of the payments
examples.why: the judge saw the $419.33 total in the rule line; $379.33 is the bulk

checklist_comparison.method: Same text-based checks on the model-written text of v3 sentences and v4 kept lines (pack figures excluded), plus v4's citation-based checklist. v3 ran on synth-v1 data, v4 on synth-v2: same selection method, different alerts. v3 had no reason or next-step fields; its 'recommendation with reason' counts a recommendation with at least one kept sentence.
